note: Tag keys a place record may carry. Each tag carries the source it came from. Ownership and welcome tags rest on the owner's own words, a press profile that names the owner, or a public directory. Tier cited = a named page; harvested = a public directory or list fetched by a tool; field = someone stood there.

entries.label: Black-owned
entries.evidence: the owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, a Black-owned business directory

entries.label: Woman-owned
entries.evidence: the owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, a women-owned business certification (WBENC, WOSB)

entries.label: LGBTQ+ welcoming
entries.evidence: the business's own statement, a press list whose framing says the businesses in it are LGBTQ-owned, or a public directory (an LGBTQ chamber of commerce, a Pride business list, OpenStreetMap lgbtq=welcome)

entries.label: Family-run
entries.evidence: a press profile or the business's own history

entries.label: Naked, no breading
entries.evidence: the menu, the business's own words, or a press piece that describes the wing

entries.label: Breaded
entries.evidence: the menu, the business's own words, or a press piece that describes the wing

entries.label: Smoked
entries.evidence: the menu or a press piece describing the cook

entries.label: Sauce made in house
entries.evidence: the business's own words or a press piece

entries.label: Wing night
entries.evidence: the business's own listing or a dated press piece; name the night in `note`

entries.label: Halal
entries.evidence: the business's own statement or a halal directory

entries.label: Cash only
entries.evidence: the business's own site or a dated press piece

entries.label: Closes when sold out
entries.evidence: the business's own site or a dated press piece

entries.label: Counter or window, no dining room
entries.evidence: the business's own site, a press piece, or OpenStreetMap takeaway=only

entries.label: Bar, 21 and over
entries.evidence: the business's own site or a dated press piece

entries.label: Closed
entries.evidence: a dated press piece or the business's own notice
